title: Environmental Assessment Act of Bhutan 2000
citation: Environmental Assessment Act 2000 (Royal Government of Bhutan; National Environment Commission)
evidence: Art. 3 of the English text (Depository of Laws PDF 8aaa.pdf, identical file on moenr.gov.bt): "It shall enter into force on 13th day of 5th of the Iron Dragon year corresponding to the 14th day of July, 2000." Opened 2026-11-03.
notes: Depository of Laws is a hash-routed app with no stable page per instrument, so official_url is the file or API response the text was read from. Environmental clearance and strategic environmental assessment for plans, policies, programmes and projects; no climate or emissions disclosure duty. Languages stored on 2026-11-03: en (PDF text layer) and dz (Dzongkha PDF 4515.pdf, uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF: the text layer is legacy-font mojibake; tesseract 5.3.4 with the dzo language pack, 300 dpi, page segmentation mode 6, not corrected, reflowed or reworded by hand). Art. 66 says that on a difference of interpretation the Dzongkha text is final and binding, so the OCR record is the text that prevails and is also the weakest record in the set. The 2016 Environmental Assessment Regulation was not found on any official page that answered (the National Environment Commission site did not answer; the MoENR page lists only 'EC-exempted-and-delegated-2016.pdf', a list, not the regulation), so it has no entry. No English translation row: both languages are the enacted text.

title: National Environment Protection Act of Bhutan 2007
citation: National Environment Protection Act 2007 (National Assembly, 87th Session, 21 June 2007)
evidence: Section 1(b) of the English text (MoENR PDF): "It shall come into force on the 16th day of the 6th month of the Female Fire Pig Year of the Bhutanese calendar, corresponding to 31st July 2007." Opened 2026-11-03.
notes: Establishes the National Environment Commission and the environmental clearance, standards and polluter duties that the Environmental Assessment Act and the Waste Prevention and Management Regulation build on. The Depository of Laws lists the Act (record 81) without a document copy, so the text comes from the MoENR page. Languages stored on 2026-11-03: en (PDF text layer) and dz (MoENR Dzongkha PDF, uncorrected OCR output of an official PDF whose text layer drops glyphs; tesseract 5.3.4 with the dzo language pack, 300 dpi, page segmentation mode 6, not corrected, reflowed or reworded by hand; the first lines are OCR noise from the cover). No English translation row: both languages are the enacted text.

title: Waste Prevention and Management Act of Bhutan 2009
citation: Waste Prevention and Management Act 2009 (Parliament, 3rd session of the First Parliament)
evidence: Art. 1(b) of the only text the Depository serves (English PDF 5cec.pdf) leaves the date blank: "Come into force on the …..day of the ….month of the Earth Ox Year of the Bhutanese calendar, corresponding to the ….day…. 2009." No official page that answered gives the date. Opened 2026-11-03.
notes: Depository of Laws is a hash-routed app with no stable page per instrument, so official_url is the file or API response the text was read from. Link only: a record needs the date the text took effect and the only official text has the commencement clause blank, so no in_force date can be read. The Depository serves English only (documentCopies lists one ENG file, no Dzongkha); no Dzongkha text was found on the MoENR page either. Implemented by bt-waste-regulation-2012, which says it is adopted under Section 53 of this Act.
status_note: Commencement date blank in the official text; nothing stored until an official page states it.

title: Carbon Markets Rules for the Kingdom of Bhutan 2023
citation: Carbon Market Rules for the Kingdom of Bhutan 2023 (National Environment Commission)
evidence: Preface of the English text (MoENR PDF): "the 56th National Environment Commission Meeting held on 27th March 2023 adopted the “Carbon Market Rules for the Kingdom of Bhutan, 2023”". The Rules have no commencement clause, so the adoption date is taken as in_force. Opened 2026-11-03.
notes: Replaces the register's nec.gov.bt download URL (did not answer from the cloud address: connection reset) with the copy on the ministry page https://www.moenr.gov.bt/?page_id=941. The same Rules are in the Depository of Laws as delegated legislation 55 (sections JSON, English only, enactmentDate 2023-03-27, updatedAt 2025-03-26); the Depository entry has no Dzongkha text (title_dzo and every clause_dzo empty), and no Dzongkha version was found on the MoENR page. Language stored: en. Binding scope is limited to participation in carbon markets (authorisation and validation or verification). The Carbon Markets Framework for the Kingdom of Bhutan 2025 (said to consolidate the Rules) was not found on moenr.gov.bt, in its search, or in the Depository; the carbon markets portal https://carbonmarketsplatform.moenr.gov.bt/ is a JavaScript app that returned an empty shell to curl. Not entered.

title: Green Tax Rules and Regulations of Bhutan 2024
citation: Green Tax Rules and Regulations of Bhutan 2024 (Ministry of Finance, under s. 8 of the Tax (Amendment) Act 2020)
evidence: Rule 3 of the English text (Depository of Laws, delegated legislation 241, status MODIFIED): "shall come into force on the 11th Day of 7th Month of the Wood Male Dragon Year, corresponding to the 15th August, 2024." Opened 2026-11-03.
notes: Environmental levy on motor vehicles, motor and high-speed diesel and heavy equipment, assessed on FOB value; it does not measure emissions, so F3 (emissions duty) is a judgement for Varun. The Depository serves the current text only (status MODIFIED), so one consolidated record. Language stored: en. The Dzongkha fields (clause_dzo) of the sections JSON hold the placeholder 'NA' in every clause, so no Dzongkha record exists.

title: Corporate Governance and Corporate Social Responsibility Regulations for Companies in Bhutan 2022 (amended 2024)
citation: Corporate Governance and Corporate Social Responsibility Regulations for Companies in Bhutan 2022 (amended 2024) (Corporate Regulatory Authority)
evidence: Rule 1(2) of the English text (Depository of Laws, delegated legislation 238, status MODIFIED): "Come into effect force on September 1, 2024". Opened 2026-11-03.
notes: Governs corporate governance and corporate social responsibility of companies registered under the Companies Act 2016, state-owned enterprises and, as a minimum, financial institutions. The Depository serves the amended text only; the 2022 text is not served, so one consolidated record dated by the 2024 commencement clause. Language stored: en. The Dzongkha fields (clause_dzo) hold the placeholder 'NA', so no Dzongkha record exists. Whether the Regulations require any sustainability or emissions disclosure was not assessed beyond the title and application clauses.

title: Consumer Protection Act of Bhutan 2012
citation: Consumer Protection Act of Bhutan 2012 (Parliament, 8th Session of the First Parliament, enacted 16 January 2012)
evidence: Section 1(b) of the English text (Depository of Laws PDF 7e68.pdf): "Come into force on the 4th Day of the 4th Month of Water Male Dragon Year of the Bhutanese Calendar corresponding to the 25th Day of May 2012". Opened 2026-11-03.
notes: Depository of Laws is a hash-routed app with no stable page per instrument, so official_url is the file or API response the text was read from. General consumer-protection law; section 6 bars false or misleading representations about goods. No provision aimed at environmental claims was found by reading the section headings, so F6 is the umbrella reading in the brief, not a green-claims rule. The PDF is bilingual: pages 3 and 7 onward (odd) are Dzongkha with a text layer, pages 6 and 8 onward (even) are English. dz = the odd pages from 3, en = the even pages, split by the script of each page; page 1 (cover) has a legacy-font text layer of private-use glyphs and is left out, pages 2, 4 and 5 have no text. Both languages are the enacted text; no translation row.
